source_notes: Pin count from the sheet: three per side, twelve in all. Kept the chip body (60.62 x 63.46 px, corner radius 8.5) and the inner square (21.3 x 22.15 px) at the sheet's proportion, about 4 percent taller than wide. The catalogue says 'square', but both squares carry the same proportion while the round dots in the same crop are true circles, so the proportion is in the drawing, not a stretch of the raster. Squaring them would move the top and bottom edges about 1.4 px each; I left that for review. The inner square keeps the round joins, as drawn.
